method: Home key applied via vendor control; t_ack = HTTP response after press_key; t_change = first canvas draw whose 48x106 downscaled frame differs from previous by mean abs diff > 3; latency = t_change - t_ack
input_side_after_end_fix: gesture down injection 156ms + up ack 2ms (same-day journal 439a5196)
caveat: Includes launcher transition onset and canvas draw; excludes compositor paint (~1 frame) and input-side 156ms. Not a pure codec benchmark.
note: Prior 2s click delay was missing gesture end (vendor 2s idle timeout), fixed in 4159576; H.264 presentation is not the cause.
